profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: San Diego County, California, United States
profile.summary: PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT with a solid technical background in hardware and software design of controls for aerospace, automotive and appliance industries.

positions.title: Principal Software Architect
positions.description: Developed software for bulldozer electrohydraulic controller, software architecture was designed in line with safety standards ISO 25119 and ISO 13849. Software development of these controllers was performed utilizing Simulink model based combined with C and assembly code. Other activities included test case development for software validation.

positions.title: Senior Software/Computer Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for various Boeing Dreamliner motor controllers, software development was performed in line with aerospace DO-178B standard. Development of these controllers was performed using Texas Instruments DSP processor C2000 family. Other activities included software requirement development, System requirement validation thru simulation (Simulink or Saber) and also software validation activities.

positions.title: Quality Manager / Customer Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for quality technical support of customers  for the Appliance Industry. Also supported internal quality related activities for product development, lead FMEA (design/process), and APQP processes.

*  Successfully identified and resolved quality related issues during project design phases and projects in production 
*  Proactively assisted R&D in the redesign of projects – Motor Controls platform for cost and quality improvements
*  Leads FMEA (design/process), prepares quality control plans, process flow charts and statistics
*  Quality  support for North American customers (South and Midwest regions)  
*  Quality interface for Diehl Mexico and China manufacturing locations to proactively address quality related issues (customer and internal)
*  Tracks quality of products (internal/ field returns), for manufacturing issues or component failures

positions.title: Jr. Test Engineer
positions.description:
*  Successfully redesign old testing equipment to improve testing ability, reduce testing  time, maintenance and size of equipment
*  Responsible to design, develop and test all aspects of electro-mechanical and electro-hydraulic testing equipment
*  Responsible for installation, maintenance and calibration of electrical testing equipment
Responsible to provide technical assistance to manufacturing 
*  Actively participated and technically supported Lean manufacturing event
